```{r}
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)
library(tidycensus)
library(sf)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
#| cache: true
income_tx <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  state = "TX",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = TRUE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
age_ca <- get_acs(
  geography = "county",
  variables = c(median_age = "B01002_001", population = "B01003_001"),
  state = "CA",
  year = 2020,
  geometry = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
#| message: false
edu_state <- get_acs(
  geography = "state",
  variables = c("B15003_001", "B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025"),
  summary_var = "B15003_001",
  year = 2020
)
```

```{r}
edu_state |>
  filter(variable %in% c("B15003_022", "B15003_023", "B15003_024", "B15003_025")) |>
  group_by(GEOID, NAME) |>
  summarise(
    percent_bachelor_plus = 100 * sum(estimate, na.rm = TRUE) / first(summary_est),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(percent_bachelor_plus)) |>
  print()
```

```{r}
ggplot(income_tx) +
  geom_sf(aes(fill = estimate), color = "white", linewidth = 0.1) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c(labels = scales::label_dollar()) +
  labs(
    title = "Median Household Income by Texas County",
    fill = "Median household income",
    caption = "Source: U.S. Census Bureau, 2020 American Community Survey 5-year estimates."
  ) +
  theme_void() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```
